Class Unchecked

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.runtime.helpers.Unchecked
public class Unchecked extends Object
Unchecked running/ calling. Unchecked means Runnable or Callable can throw exceptions (which don't need to extend RuntimeException).

This code was borrowed from:

exceptions in lambda
